newsitem.title: USA: Mass. debates bonds for homes and courts.
newsitem.headline: Mass. debates bonds for homes and courts.

text.p: Six conferees were to meet this week to try and find common ground in differing versions of a $685 million plan to upgrade the state's courthouses.
The bond authorization is deemed a top priority by Massachusetts's judicial community.
The problem is the Senate added several projects to the bond bill, but provided no additional funding.

Meanwhile the Massachusetts Committee on Housing and Urban Development is expected to take up a $375 million housing bond issue on Thursday. The measure would provide $220 million for modernization of existing housing, $75 million to acquire old buildings and turn them into affordable units, and a fund to help non-profit orgnizations buy and preserve properties. (( --Boston bureau, 617-367-4106))
